en_title: The Lord of the Rings: Shadow of the Past in Scriptwriting Stage Following Cancellation Rumors, Peter Jackson Confirms
cn_title: 杰克逊：《指环王》新片仍在写剧本
subtitle: 重返中土的漫长旅途
opus_summary: 彼得·杰克逊回应《指环王》新片取消传闻，确认影片仍在剧本创作阶段，目前尚未定档。他还透露，《追寻咕噜》预计再拍两周便可杀青，接下来将拍摄《丁丁历险记2》。

paragraphs.en: Peter Jackson has confirmed The Lord of the Rings: Shadow of the Past is in the scriptwriting stage following cancellation rumors that emerged in the wake of the Paramount-Warner Bros. merger .
paragraphs.cn: 派拉蒙与华纳兄弟合并后，曾传出《指环王：Shadow of the Past》被取消的消息。彼得·杰克逊现已确认，该片正处于剧本创作阶段。

paragraphs.en: The filmmaker behind the fantasy franchise's original live-action trilogy gave a much-needed update at the Sitges Film Festival (via ScreenRant ). When accepting the Honorary Grand Prize, Jackson took a moment to talk about where The Lord of the Rings stands in the movie world.
paragraphs.cn: 据ScreenRant报道，执导了这一奇幻系列最初三部真人电影的杰克逊，在锡切斯电影节上带来了大家急需的消息。他在领取荣誉大奖时，抽空谈到了《指环王》系列电影的近况。

paragraphs.en: It's Shadow of the Past that most fans may be scratching their heads about, though. Announced by Warner Bros. and New Line Cinema in March, The Lord of the Rings story is being written by Philippa Boyens, Peter McGee, and perhaps most notably, former Late Show host and franchise fan Stephen Colbert. Earlier this month, outlet Knight Edge Media reported that the newly formed Skydance had paused the project.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，最让影迷摸不清状况的，或许还是《Shadow of the Past》。华纳兄弟与新线影业于3月公布了这部《指环王》新片，剧本由Philippa Boyens、Peter McGee，以及或许最引人注目的Stephen Colbert共同创作。Colbert曾主持《深夜秀》，也是该系列的影迷。本月早些时候，媒体Knight Edge Media报道称，新组建的Skydance已暂停该项目。

paragraphs.en: Considering the sudden end of The Late Show with Stephen Colbert earlier this year, fans begin to fear the worst for Shadow of the Past. Warner Bros. did eventually clarify to the outlet that the project had not been outright canceled. Jackson, however, didn't skip a beat when promising that work for the movie was still very much underway.
paragraphs.cn: 考虑到《斯蒂芬·科尔伯特深夜秀》在今年早些时候突然停播，影迷开始担心《Shadow of the Past》也会遭遇最坏的结果。华纳兄弟最终向该媒体澄清，项目并未被彻底取消。而杰克逊则毫不迟疑地保证，影片的筹备工作仍在继续。

paragraphs.en: "We have The Shadow of the Past, which is in the scriptwriting stage," he said.
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「我们还有《The Shadow of the Past》，目前正在创作剧本。」

paragraphs.en: It's not much, but it should be good news for those who have missed taking trips to the theater to see The Lord of the Rings films. Despite supposedly being so early in development – and its work-in-progress title – we do already know a bit about Shadow of the Past's story.
paragraphs.cn: 消息虽然不多，但对于怀念去影院观看《指环王》的观众来说，这应该算是个好消息。尽管据称该片仍处于非常早期的开发阶段，片名也尚未最终确定，我们已经知道了一些《Shadow of the Past》的故事细节。

paragraphs.en: Jackson and Colbert promised that the trilogy follow-up movie would take place 14 years after Hobbit Frodo had passed. It's said to instead see "Sam, Merry, and Pippin set out to retrace the first steps of their adventure. Meanwhile, Sam’s daughter, Elanor, has discovered a long-buried secret and is determined to uncover why the War of the Ring was very nearly lost before it even began."
paragraphs.cn: 杰克逊与Colbert此前承诺，这部延续三部曲的电影将以霍比特人弗罗多离世14年后为背景。据介绍，故事将转而讲述「山姆、梅里和皮平动身重走当年冒险最初的路程。与此同时，山姆的女儿埃拉诺发现了一个尘封已久的秘密，决心查明为何魔戒圣战还未开始，就险些败局已定。」

paragraphs.en: Jackson also took his Sitges acceptance speech as an opportunity to deliver an update on another, much further along project: The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum . Production on the Andy Serkis-led film is underway , but it sounds like they won't be filming for too much longer. Jackson is in the mix on this one as well, with the plan being for him to work on Tintin 2 next.
paragraphs.cn: 杰克逊还借锡切斯电影节的获奖感言，介绍了另一部进度快得多的作品——《指环王：追寻咕噜》。这部由安迪·瑟金斯主导的电影正在拍摄，不过听起来距离杀青已经不远。杰克逊也参与了该片，按计划，他接下来将投入《丁丁历险记2》的制作。

paragraphs.en: "The Hunt for Gollum is almost finished filming. I think there are about two weeks of shooting left. And we've also already written the script for Tintin 2, the second Tintin film. That will be the next film I make."
paragraphs.cn: 「《追寻咕噜》快拍完了。我想大概还剩两周的拍摄。我们也已经写完了《丁丁历险记2》的剧本，也就是第二部丁丁电影。那将是我接下来拍摄的电影。」

paragraphs.en: The Lord of the Rings: Shadow of the Past is still making the long trek to become an actual movie, but does not currently have a release date. The Hunt for Gollum will premiere December 17, 2027. In the meantime, you can read what Colbert had to say to those concerned about his involvement .
paragraphs.cn: 《指环王：Shadow of the Past》距离真正拍成电影仍有漫长的路要走，目前尚未定档。《追寻咕噜》将于2027年12月17日首映。
